tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side view of keeping the adjustable mortgage after the reset versus the fixed-rate refinance quote, including payment estimates, closing costs, and cash reserve impact for Liora and Jonah Nettlewhisk.

tickets.title: Review Concentrated Position
tickets.text: Assess position size, tax basis, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, trading restrictions, and diversification options before recommending any action. Apply this review to the Clockwork Clover Systems stock position valued at $156,000 with a $42,000 cost basis in the joint taxable brokerage account of Liora and Jonah Nettlewhisk, and compare partial sale, staged sale, pledged-asset alternatives, and no-sale options for debt reduction.

tickets.title: Address appraisal and rate-lock readiness items

tickets.title: Show non-retirement funding options analysis
tickets.text: Prepare an analysis for Liora Nettlewhisk showing non-retirement funding options for debt restructuring, ensuring IRA or 401(k) withdrawals are only considered as a last-resort scenario, and present alternatives before any retirement-account cash-flow scenario.
tickets.evidence: For the retirement-account boundary for debt restructuring, Liora stated that IRA or 401(k) withdrawals should be treated only as a last-resort scenario, and the agreed planning analysis is to show non-retirement funding options before any retirement-account cash-flow scenario by 2025-02-03.
